item.title: Extreme weather in Sri Lanka : Death toll rises to 39
item.description: The Disaster Management Centre (DMC) reports that 39 disaster‑related deaths have occurred so far due to the prevailing adverse weather conditions in Sri Lanka. Seventy‑nine Divisional Secretariat divisions across 17 districts have been affected. item.title: Australia pledges AUD 1 million to support Sri Lanka’s disaster relief efforts
item.description: The Australian High Commission in Sri Lanka has announced that Australia is providing AUD 1 million to assist with immediate response and recovery efforts following the impacts of Cyclone Ditwah. item.title: Sri Lanka Flood Death Toll Rises To 212 & 218 Missing
item.description: The Disaster Management Center reports that the flood crisis gripping Sri Lanka has worsened, with 998,918 people from 273,606 families affected across 25 districts as of 4:00 p.m. today (30). item.title: Sri Lanka Death Toll Climbs to 334, With 370 Still Missing
item.description: At least 334 people have died and 370 remain missing, according to the latest situation reports issued by the Disaster Management Centre (DMC).
